statement: Dedicated supports LDAP, Kerberos and smart card authentication like Self-Managed.

evidence.quote: LDAP authentication Authentication using corporate LDAP/Active Directory credentials. Must use GitLab-specific passwords or access tokens instead.
Kerberos authentication Single sign-on authentication using Kerberos protocol. Must authenticate separately to GitLab.
How can users be auto-provisioned? - **Short answer**: Use LDAP integration

expected: Corrected: LDAP, Kerberos and smart card authentication are listed as unavailable on Dedicated (use SAML or OIDC SSO, SCIM). "A small number of exceptions" is not "everything".

statement: AB-0082 says a pre-production environment is included and covered by the 99.9% objective; AB-0081 says it is a paid add-on with no SLA.

evidence.quote: Pre-production environments must be purchased as an add-on to your GitLab Dedicated subscription, with no additional licenses required.
Single-region deployment only. - No SLA commitment. - Cannot run newer versions than production.

expected: The two entries are recognised as the same question and the conflict flagged; AB-0081 wins; AB-0082 is superseded or needs-person.

statement: AB-0084 gives a 90-day retention window after expiry; AB-0083 (and the docs) say 30 days of access, then termination and deletion.

evidence.quote: After 30 days, if your data is not archived or migrated to another instance, your instance is terminated and all Customer Content is deleted.
You can request confirmation of account removal 90 days after instance termination.

expected: Conflict flagged; 30 days (15 days to request preservation) is the answer; the 90 days is the confirmation-of-removal window, not retention. AB-0084 superseded.
